references.text: Moses designates three cities of refuge east of the Jordan: Bezer, Ramoth, and Golan, fulfilling the requirement for three cities on the eastern side of the river.
Gives detailed instructions to set aside three cities of refuge in the land of Canaan, corresponding with the three cities west of the Jordan mentioned in the verse.
Mentions the possibility of adding three more cities to the original three, and confirms the arrangement of cities of refuge in the promised land.
The fulfillment of the command to designate six cities of refuge: three west of the Jordan (Kedesh, Shechem, Kiriath-Arba) and three east of the Jordan (Bezer, Ramoth, Golan).
Hebron is given to the descendants of Aaron as a city of refuge, one of the cities west of the Jordan.
Introduces the concept of six cities of refuge to be given to the Levites.
The earliest command for a place of refuge for someone who kills another unintentionally, forming the basis for the system of cities of refuge.
